protocol.workload: Twelve closed-corpus Vite runtime, migration and build claims. Conditions include reordered results, a simulated single-source timeout, and a full source outage.
protocol.scoring: Exact target-release verdict. Superseded counts as contradicted. Source outage requires abstention.
protocol.consistency: Fraction of tasks with the same verdict and no errors across all repetitions.
protocol.metrics: Steps are trace events. Tool calls count harness-observed searches, manifest reads and adapter calls. Internal adapter operations are outside this count. Latency is observed wall time. Unknown provider tokens and USD remain null.

provenance.billing: Local CPU inference. Provider cost is shown only when it was reported.
